unlisted_practices: Training a therapeutic chatbot in a multi-agent simulated environment with stressor injection
Dynamic injection of clinically grounded therapeutic strategies (motivational interviewing, CBT) into LLM agent
Persistent memory across multiple sessions for behavior change support

screen.reason: The paper introduces and benchmarks a novel multi-agent LLM system (ChatThero) for addiction recovery support in a simulated environment evaluated by clinicians and LLM-as-judge, without testing an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
